version_policy: C4.4 bumps the protocol: conversation-cognition-proposal-v6 (token rename + ref handles) and language-realization-input-v7; the frozen CognitionProposalV0 body is unchanged
citation_binding: every factual_assessment.claims[*].source_handles entry must be an advertised F handle and must also appear in cognition.considered_handles AND cognition.evidence_handles; the host binds the citation and refuses the turn otherwise
ref_handles: host-issued, turn-local, deterministic, wire-only handles: F* resolves in FACTUAL SOURCE REFS, C* in the remaining CITEABLE CONTEXT REFS (namespaces disjoint, one handle per ref); unknown, malformed, duplicate or namespace-escalating handles fail closed; canonical refs remain authoritative and are the only refs hashed or stored

grounding.production_rule: stance remains the free-text choice authority; Language must not semantically complete it
grounding.experiment_rule: a SELECTED stance must be classifiable within the scenario's requested option pair, otherwise OFF_QUESTION_STANCE

contract_legibility.repaired_defect: none (C4.4 changes the selection semantics and the model-wire ref format)
contract_legibility.handle_canonicalization: F* = factual-source namespace, C* = citeable-context namespace; exact advertised match only; unknown/malformed/namespace-escalating handles fail closed; canonical refs are authoritative and stored
contract_legibility.wire_vs_authoritative: conversation-cognition-proposal-v6 model wire carries handles; the authoritative proposal and hash carry canonical refs

schema_authority.factual_source_authority: subject:, entity: and environment: refs remain non-factual sources; only the F* factual-source handles (resolved to FACTUAL SOURCE REFS) may appear in factual_assessment.claims[*].source_handles
schema_authority.host_binding: CognitionInvocationBindingV2 / LanguageInvocationBindingV0 in-flight bindings; no model-emitted projection_hash; canonical refs are host-resolved from exact advertised handles

session_id_policy: opaque UUID per cell (c44-<uuid>), no scenario/condition/replicate identity
